title: USGS prediction of a La Palma collapse tsunami
place_text: La Palma Island; US East Coast

tellings.quote: And uh the US Geological Service has predicted that uh that would cause a tsunami that in some places would wipe out up to 26 miles inland on the east US coast.

plain: A former Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan, speaking on Jesse Michels' podcast, describes a warning about La Palma, an island in the Atlantic. He says the US Geological Survey, the government's earth science agency, has predicted that if part of the island collapsed it would set off a tsunami that in places could reach up to 26 miles inland along the US East Coast. He tells it as a picture of how big a disaster could one day hit that coast.
